problem_text: A ±1-sequence is a sequence of 2022 numbers a_1, ..., a_2022, each equal to either +1 or -1. Determine the largest C so that, for any ±1-sequence, there exists an integer k and indices 1 ≤ t_1 < ... < t_k ≤ 2022 so that t_{i+1} - t_i ≤ 2 for all i, and |sum_{i=1}^{k} a_{t_i}| ≥ C.
solution_text: Upper bound: Construct the sequence (+1,-1,-1,+1) repeated 505 times followed by (+1,-1). Using DP f[i]=a_i+max(0,f[i-1],f[i-2]) and g[i]=a_i+min(0,g[i-1],g[i-2]), verify that max|f| and max|g| are both exactly 506. Lower bound: For any ±1 sequence, define F[i]=max(0,f[i]) and G[i]=max(0,-g[i]). Show that over any block of 4 consecutive positions, max(F,G) increases by at least 1 (case analysis: p=0,4 give +4; p=1,3 give +2; p=2 gives +1 via max-of-two anti-cancellation). Since 2022=4×505+2 gives 506 blocks (505 of size 4, 1 of size 2), max(F,G)≥506, so some subsequence has |sum|≥506. Combined: C=506.
solution_summary: Upper bound via (+1,-1,-1,+1) pattern construction giving max|sum|=506; lower bound via potential function F[i]=max(0,f[i]), G[i]=max(0,-g[i]) showing each block of 4 increases max(F,G) by ≥1, yielding 506 blocks → 506.
structure_features: ±1 sequence of length 2022, subsequence with gap ≤ 2 constraint (equivalent to no 2 consecutive unselected elements), minimax problem (largest C guaranteed for any sequence), 2022=4×505+2 implies block size 4
thinking_patterns: potential function argument (F and G tracking max/min sums with floor at 0)
DP formulation (skip-at-most-one subsequence as path with steps 1 or 2)
case analysis on block composition (p=0,1,2,3,4 positives per block)
key_insight: Define F[i]=max(0,f[i]) and G[i]=max(0,-g[i]); the max-of-two mechanism in the DP prevents full cancellation in balanced blocks, guaranteeing each block of 4 increases max(F,G) by at least 1, giving 506 blocks → 506

translation_to: potential function dynamics (F and G tracking running max/min sums with floor at 0, block increment analysis)

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构：已知什么、约束什么、要求什么？gap≤2在子序列选择中意味着什么？
rounds.expected_answer: 这是一个minimax问题：对任意±1序列求最大C使得存在gap≤2的子序列|sum|≥C。gap≤2意味着相邻选中元素间最多跳过1个，等价于未选元素不能连续2个。需要同时证上界（构造序列使max|sum|≤506）和下界（任意序列max|sum|≥506）。

rounds.question: 列出所有可能用来bound C的方法：上界构造和下界证明分别有哪些方向？
rounds.expected_answer: 上界：尝试具体pattern（交替、常数、周期4等）并用DP验证max|sum|。下界：DP直接分析、分块+势函数、鸽巢原理、贪心走法。关键观察2022=4×505+2，506=⌈2022/4⌉暗示分块大小为4。

rounds.question: 试交替序列(+1,-1,+1,-1,...)，计算可达到的最大|sum|。
rounds.expected_answer: 选所有奇数位（gap=2）得sum=1011，太大。交替序列不是好的上界构造，因为它允许选出所有同号元素。需要找一种pattern使得在任何gap≤2的子序列中正负贡献相互抵消。

rounds.question: 考虑将2022个位置分成4个一组。什么样的周期4的±1 pattern能最小化每块内可达到的最大|sum|？验证pattern (+1,-1,-1,+1) 的性质。
rounds.expected_answer: (+1,-1,-1,+1)是平衡的：块内和为0，且对称结构使得DP值在块边界处增长缓慢。用DP f[i]=a_i+max(0,f[i-1],f[i-2])和g[i]=a_i+min(0,g[i-1],g[i-2])验证，重复505次后接(+1,-1)，max|f|和max|g|恰好=506。

rounds.question: 对pattern (+1,-1,-1,+1)×505+(+1,-1)，具体计算DP值，确认上界为506。
rounds.expected_answer: 每个完整4块结束后dp值增加1（block j结束时dp[4j]=j, dn[4j]=-(j+1)）。505块后dp[2020]=505, dn[2020]=-506。最后两个位置(+1,-1)使dp[2021]=506, dn[2022]=-506。全局max|sum|=506，上界成立。

rounds.question: 下界证明：定义F[i]=max(0,f[i])和G[i]=max(0,-g[i])。证明在任意4个连续位置中max(F,G)至少增长1。
rounds.expected_answer: 对4块中+1个数p做case analysis：p=0或4时增≥4；p=1或3时增≥2；p=2时（关键case），DP的max-of-two机制防止完全消去——一个-1导致的F下降不影响下一个+1的增量，因为max(f[i-1],f[i-2])保留了高水位。6种p=2排列逐一验证均增≥1。

rounds.question: 综合上下界：505个4块+1个2块=506块，每块增≥1，得max(F,G)≥506，即存在子序列|sum|≥506。结合上界构造得C=506。
rounds.expected_answer: 2022=4×505+2自然分解为506块。下界：每块max(F,G)增≥1，506块后≥506。上界：(+1,-1,-1,+1) pattern给出max|sum|=506。因此C=506。
